pages.title: Best AI Writing Tools (2026): Data-Driven Comparison
pages.metaDescription: A data-driven comparison of AI writing tools with verified 2026 pricing and affiliate commission data: Jasper, Writesonic and Scalenut (checked 2026-08-07).
pages.intro: This page compares AI writing tools using verified, dated data only: official pricing pages fetched on 2026-08-07, commission terms from each vendor's official affiliate agreement, and each tool's stated plan structure. We do not claim to have tested these tools; the comparison is based on price, plan, feature and commission data, not hands-on review.
comparisonCriteria: Starting price and billing options (official pricing pages, fetched 2026-08-07)
Affiliate commission rate and whether it recurs
Commission window and cookie duration (official affiliate pages)
Ratings from named sources only (G2 / Capterra / TAAFT - none verified at publish time)

faqs.question: What is the best AI writing tool in 2026?
faqs.answer: On verified 2026 data, no single tool is best for everyone. Jasper (from $59/mo) and Writesonic (from $79/mo) are the two dedicated AI writing assistants in this dataset; Scalenut (from $59/mo) adds SEO content tooling. The right pick depends on your budget, workflow and plan needs; the comparison table on this page shows the verified differences.

faqs.question: How much do AI writing tools cost?
faqs.answer: Verified on 2026-08-07: Jasper from $59/mo (annual billing, $69/mo monthly), Writesonic from $79/mo (Swipe Starter, annual billing), Scalenut from $59/mo (Starter, with a limited offer from $24/mo noted on the pricing page).

faqs.question: Which AI writing tools pay recurring affiliate commissions?
faqs.answer: Verified 2026-08-07: Jasper pays 25% recurring on Creator and Teams plans (Business excluded); Writesonic pays 20% recurring for 12 months; Scalenut pays 30-50% recurring for life.

faqs.question: How are ratings sourced on this page?
faqs.answer: Ratings are only shown when they come from a named source (G2, Capterra or TAAFT). No named-source rating was verified for any tool on this page at publish time, so ratings are marked 'not verified' rather than guessed.
